items.title: Treat TEST-admissible routine validate as official heavy certification
items.context: B-1e1f CHK-003 limited isOfficialHeavyValidateInvocation to validate --full. runValidateGate in handlers/phase-gates.ts calls verifier.validate({ json:true, story }) without --full, which is exactly this repo’s 103-command validate.commands suite. Extend the shared official-heavy predicate (or a sibling consumed by the same refuseHeavyCertificationUnlessAdmitted choke) so that unscoped story-scoped validate is heavy. --channel/--concept/--lint stay non-heavy. --focus and other 1-3 minute focused smokes stay non-heavy. Do not invent a second window type. Do not change doneRequiredCommands membership.
items.userSees: Running proof-or-stop validate --story=B-xxxx without --full/--focus/--channel/--concept/--lint, when no CertificationWindow is ADMITTED or RUNNING, prints [pre_cert_window_required] Official heavy certification requires a current ADMITTED or RUNNING CertificationWindow. and Next: proof-or-stop certification_window_begin --storyId=B-xxxx. The same command with --lint or --focus still runs without that error.

items.title: Refuse REVIEW-phase starts of the TEST-admissible suite until a window is ADMITTED
items.context: B-cc10 ran routine validate 29 times while phase remained REVIEW because story_advance TEST and bare validate both spawn the suite before PRE_CERT. After CHK-001’s classification, the choke must fire at both entries: (1) verifier.validate for a story-scoped unscoped run, (2) runValidateGate used by story_advance --phase=TEST. A missing/BLOCKED/INVALIDATED/CANCELLED window must throw [pre_cert_window_required] and must not spawn validate.commands children. Fresh stored PASS reuse (assessStoredValidationPassAdmissibility) remains allowed only when the PASS is bound to the current admitted frozen identity. Express/fast still skip CLI preflight only, not this choke, because they still execute the same validate.commands list.
items.userSees: From a REVIEW story with no admitted window, proof-or-stop story_advance --storyId=B-xxxx --phase=TEST fails before the 103-command suite starts, with [pre_cert_window_required] and Next: proof-or-stop certification_window_begin --storyId=B-xxxx. No validate.commands child process is created.
excludes: Skipping the final full validate after an admitted window

items.title: Admit PRE_CERT for the TEST suite only from B-3f3d saturated inventory, not completeness-only stubs
items.context: B-1e1f added review_inventory_finalize as inventory-completeness-only with authorizesTest=false so PRE_CERT could admit without U-01a. B-3f3d’s finalize can still mint that completeness fallback when no OPEN epoch exists. Remaining U-01: certification_window_begin must fail closed on completeness-only receipts when the operator is requesting TEST-admissible heavy certification. Admit only a current-hash FINALIZED unconsumed saturated receipt (required lanes terminal, critic, zero-new-finding wave as B-3f3d defines). Inventory still must not set authorizesTest=true; the window remains the only TEST-suite authority. Depends on B-3f3d landing on main; do not fork review-inventory-epoch.ts.
items.userSees: proof-or-stop certification_window_begin --storyId=B-xxxx with only an inventory-completeness-only receipt prints State: BLOCKED and blocker [pre_cert_inventory_not_finalized] (or a stable sibling code) telling the operator to run review_inventory_begin and finalize a saturated epoch. After a saturated FINALIZED receipt on the current hashes, the same command prints State: ADMITTED.

items.title: Require a hash-bound validate --focus=fast pass as the PRE_CERT cheap-check fact without running the full suite
items.context: U-01 §7.1.4 item 3 requires a cheap focused/adversarial check before heavy certification. The REVIEW-to-TEST preflight is not the producer: it runs only inside story_advance TEST and currently logs no persistable fact, so it cannot be required before certification_window_begin. Use exactly proof-or-stop validate --story=B-xxxx --focus=fast --json as the sole REVIEW-available producer. It runs only existing commands tagged focus:["fast"], remains non-heavy, and must persist a signed PRE_CERT cheap-check receipt bound to story ID, PASS, RoutineValidationIdentity with invocation.focus=fast, headHash, materialHash, and storyFilesHash. certification_window_begin consumes only a fresh matching receipt and fails closed on missing, failed, tampered, or drifted evidence. Do not create a runner or use the 103-command unscoped suite; --channel/--concept/--lint remain transition preflight and do not substitute for this receipt unless they gain equivalent signed identity-bound persistence.
items.userSees: certification_window_begin on a candidate with saturated inventory, merge, coverage, and a clean tree but no current PRE_CERT cheap-check receipt prints State: BLOCKED with a stable cheap-check blocker and Next: proof-or-stop validate --story=B-xxxx --focus=fast. That command runs only configured fast-tagged commands and persists a PASS receipt bound to the current hashes; the same certification_window_begin then may print State: ADMITTED. It never starts the 103-command suite.
excludes: Treating the 103-command suite as the cheap check

items.title: Prove a B-cc10-shaped REVIEW loop cannot start the suite, and one admitted window runs it at most once
items.context: Add a deterministic replay/smoke: REVIEW fixture, no window, both validate --story and story_advance TEST are refused with zero validate.commands children. After a fixture admit on a saturated inventory plus the hash-bound validate --focus=fast cheap-check receipt, exactly one official unscoped validate is allowed. A second official start on the same frozen identity must reuse the stored PASS or refuse duplicate execution. Related story-owned drift invalidates both the window and the cheap-check receipt and requires a new admit. Register the expanded choke and the cheap-check producer/consumer in process-fact-levels/registry with gateConsumer = done_required_validate / validate --full / unscoped validate --story / runValidateGate / certification_window_begin. Update scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs with a non-vacuous assertion for the named L4 process facts and their consumer source; run it in the smoke/verification evidence. Update AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and docs/CLI.md so the operator Next command is certification_window_begin, not just run validate. Do not claim the 3-8 hour saving. Do not weaken reviewer lanes.
items.userSees: The replay smoke prints a fail-closed REVIEW refusal with [pre_cert_window_required], then after a current signed fast cheap-check receipt and admit prints official heavy certification allowed once for this window; a second start on the same hashes does not spawn a second full suite. Story-owned drift invalidates the receipt and window. node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs passes while asserting the named L4 producer and consumers. session_brief / story_advance hint for a REVIEW story missing a window includes proof-or-stop certification_window_begin.
excludes: Claiming the 3-8 hour wall-clock saving without a later A/B story
